description: This file is a webpage implementing a database visualizer UI for browsing and viewing data from different databases and tables. It includes HTML structure, CSS styles, and embedded JavaScript for interactivity and data fetching.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a table cell, handling long content and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
